backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only PIT SEC filing usable date and signal-date OHLCV available after the close. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus experiment-local delayed SEC filing confirmation paper overlay

gate3.note: No core entry filter is added. The delayed SEC source is additive default-off paper; core signals and survival are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT-safe SEC filings may be underreacted to only after a 1-3 session confirmation window. Require delayed SPY/QQQ-relative leadership, high close quality, abnormal volume, liquidity, and non-parabolic trend guards before next-open paper entry.

2_history_check.difference: This is not a phrase, form, or same-day threshold retune. It tests whether delayed post-filing confirmation changes the source utility. It is scout-only because the new evidence is timing rather than richer filing semantics.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-023: SEC contract/customer/order text leadership was rejected because explicit phrase hits were too sparse.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-024: SEC earnings cadence surprise absorption was rejected with only five trades.
2_history_check.exp-20260611-001: SEC filing complexity/change density was rejected; generic filing metadata was not enough.
2_history_check.exp-20260611-012: Same-day 10-Q/10-K periodic-report absorption was rejected with nine trades and weak replacement value.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Pass only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL window regression, at least 20 target trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration passes, and the accepted distribution-day comparator is beaten. Even if positive, replay-only status is not accepted production alpha.

interpretation: The delayed SEC confirmation source was rejected under the standard three-window protocol and current accepted distribution-day comparator.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially richer PIT filing semantics or forward replacement rows. Do not sweep forms, lag days, return, volume, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping SEC forms, lag sessions, same-day return, relative-strength, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs richer PIT semantics such as named customer, supplier, contract value/duration, parsed filing surprise, or closed forward replacement-value data.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed delayed SEC confirmation bundle failed Gate 4. The likely reason is that a filing followed by delayed relative strength is still mostly generic momentum or already-priced event information after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and overlap controls.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior SEC same-day text, cadence, complexity, and periodic-report absorption variants failed. This fixed scout changes the causal timing: it waits for delayed market confirmation after a PIT-safe filing instead of retuning phrases or forms.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT-safe filing lag, confirmation fields, overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, hold, costs, cooldown, comparator, and concentration controls in historical replay and daily production.
